searchText: If 6110 and 7002 considered to be included in electra already, then would it be possible to remove these fields from spec config? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/configs/mainnet.yaml#L54 Assuming that these EIPs will be triggered with the electra fork version for any future tests anyway? Electra fork version added to config with: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3632 cc: <@199561711278227457> <@415109946682769408> There is a PR originating Electra spec and cleaning up 6110 and 7002 things including the config, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3615 is there a specific API reference for the gossip/peer to peer network stuff? Would it be under the beacon-api events section? Or is there a separate spec - e.g. the consensus spec https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md Each fork has a p2p-interface document that has all the changes specific to that fork would the right framework to think of the beacon API is as a "historical only data" and p2p as the "real time data"?
